product.olivetti-m6-750.summary: The Tin Box version of the M6 with a 50 MHz i486DX2.
product.olivetti-m6-750.history: Olivetti presented it at CeBIT in 1994 as part of its professional range. The Tin Box chassis distinguishes this version from the other M6-750.
product.olivetti-m6-750.architecture: The chassis determines the expansion available. Its riser has 3 full-length ISA slots, one short PCI slot and one shared ISA/PCI slot.
product.olivetti-m6-750.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-750.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-750.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 5
product.olivetti-m6-750.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 2.03.
